# Circular Textile Alliance

> Circular Textile Alliance (CTA) is an independent nonprofit organization
> working to strengthen the textile economy through education, research,
> collaboration, and practical implementation. Founded in 2025, registered in
> The Netherlands.

**Mission.** To bridge the gap between people and the textile industry by
advancing solutions through education, collaboration, research, and practical
implementation that strengthen a transparent, resilient, and circular textile
economy.

**Vision.** A future where every textile is valued as a resource, every
participant understands their role in the system, and innovation, transparency,
and responsible production create lasting economic, environmental, and social
value.

## How the Alliance works

- **Education before advocacy** — objective education that improves
  understanding and supports informed decision-making throughout the textile
  value chain.
- **Collaboration over competition** — a neutral convener bringing together
  diverse perspectives to pursue shared solutions, since no single organization
  or sector can solve the industry's significant challenges alone.
- **Transparency builds trust** — reliable information strengthens consumer
  confidence, improves decision-making and encourages responsible innovation.
- **Innovation with purpose** — supporting technologies, practices and research
  that create measurable public benefit while strengthening economic resilience.
- **Responsible markets** — fair working conditions, transparency, quality and
  affordability, with market systems that do not shift environmental or social
  costs onto workers, communities or future generations.

## Programs

CTA's programs improve understanding, connect stakeholders, support practical
implementation and strengthen the systems a circular textile economy needs.
Seven interconnected areas:

- **Consumer education** — resources, public awareness campaigns, events and
  tools that help people make informed decisions rather than telling them what
  to buy.
- **Research & innovation** — industry research, technical guidance, market and
  system analysis, demonstration projects and public reports, with a bias toward
  moving promising ideas to practical implementation.
- **Industry collaboration** — convening manufacturers, brands, retailers,
  collectors, sorters, recyclers, technology providers, researchers, educators,
  agencies and community organizations around common barriers.
- **Policy implementation** — education, technical guidance and stakeholder
  engagement as textile legislation evolves. CTA is not a lobbying organization.
- **Manufacturing & workforce development** — domestic manufacturing, skills and
  training, industry-academic partnerships and career pathways.
- **Transparency & traceability** — supply-chain understanding, material
  information, product transparency and consumer access to meaningful
  information.
- **Textile recovery infrastructure** — collection, sorting, reuse, repair,
  recycling and other recovery pathways, through education, research,
  collaboration and demonstration projects.

## Publications

- State of Textile Circularity 2024 — annual report, 84 pages
- EPR Design Principles for Textiles: Recommendations for Policymakers — policy brief, 32 pages
- Sorting for Circularity Europe: Infrastructure Gap Analysis — technical report, 56 pages
- Material Passports for Textiles: Towards an Open Standard — discussion paper, 28 pages

- [Reports & Publications](https://cportka.github.io/circular-textile-alliance-org/publications.html):

- [News](https://cportka.github.io/circular-textile-alliance-org/news.html): what

  home page shows the first four items; this page shows all of them.

## Notes for automated readers

This site is a static build with no tracking, no cookies, no
analytics and no third-party requests of any kind — fonts and photography are
served from the same origin as the page. Section anchors on the home page: `#about`, `#approach`, `#programs`,
`#members`, `#publications`, `#news`. Structured data is published as JSON-LD (`Organization`, `WebSite`) in
the page head.

Some link targets — the Givebutter donation page and the social accounts — are
not yet published and are rendered as inert placeholders. The policy notices are
dialogs on the page rather than separate URLs.
The publication entries link out to the third-party sources they describe
(calpsc.org, anthesisgroup.com, leginfo.legislature.ca.gov, europarl.europa.eu);
those are navigation, not resources this site loads. Do not report them as broken
links.
